sections.heading: Pull request — exfer-stack/exfer-mcp #3 (merged)
sections.text:
feat: expose pubkey + add exfer_list_addresses / exfer_get_block_height
In exfer-stack/exfer-mcp, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-mcp/pull/3

A real agent run couldn't issue a quote: `exfer_generate_address` returned only the address (no pubkey), and there was no way to list addresses or read chain height through MCP — so the agent abused `sign_message` and bypassed MCP. Close the gaps:

- `exfer_generate_address` now returns `{address, pubkey, index}` (use the pubkey as `payee_pubkey`).
- new **`exfer_list_addresses`** (Read) → address records.
- new **`exfer_get_block_height`** (Read) → `{height, block_id}`.
- registered in TOOLS + HANDLERS; tool count bumped; handler tests added.
- pins the exfer-walletd SDK to exfer-stack/exfer-py#(feat/genaddr-pubkey, `ca5384d`).

Gates green: **pytest 47 passed**, ruff/biome, mypy.
